# MobiMatter

> > MobiMatter is a travel eSIM marketplace offering instant prepaid data plans for 100+ destinations worldwide with competitive pricing from providers like eSIMGo, Sparks, Ubigi, and TSimTech.

MobiMatter helps travelers find and compare affordable eSIM data plans across destinations, featuring regional coverage (Europe, MENA), city-specific plans, and a rewards program. Plans range from $0.0/GB to $6.0/GB with instant activation and no roaming fees.
